officialChanges.text: Hajin is BR; Zodiac is Resurgence. Mixed-mode reports cannot become picks in both without actual map/mode evidence.
Current registry: 33 MW4 launch guns plus Cronen Osprey and CSG-35 at S1 launch. Recurring names need current-MW4 compatibility validation.
Legacy guns are Gunsmith-locked presets / blueprints. Old attachments are historical, not editable Season 1 builds.
Cronen Osprey is BP16 and CSG-35 BP36. Adoption is constrained by access and early lockout this launch day.
Visible Combat Record / Leaderboards arrive in S2. No official population usage statistic supports a launch-day winner.
TrueGameData said full WZ stats were in progress at 1:46 p.m. ET Nov 6. No finished dataset was found by this audit cutoff.
Afternoon official-feed check found no weapon-balance hotfix. Current incidents concern camos/skins/DMZ transitions.

Nov 11 update: every ballistic gun's true hitscan range rose 288% from launch (about 35 m on average), and long-range bullets connect 34 ms sooner. This is global and applies to Warzone; no single gun was tuned.
Known issue since Nov 11, 3:53 p.m. ET: semi-auto weapons can intermittently delay firing. That affects the sniper and marksman picks (KG-7 Vulcan, Mosin-Nagant) until fixed.

changelog.title: VEL 46 retakes the close-range pick; Squall users move to the Osprey
changelog.text: Kitted now counts the VEL 46 on 10 of 23 tracked pros (7/25 on Nov 24), with GalaxyWZ, Adriann and Kenner switching to it on Nov 25–26. The ISO drops to 8/23, so the VEL becomes the BR close-range pick again and the ISO an alternative. Hisoka’s Nov 26 VEL build (VB-46 Series 11, FSS Crackdown, Schlager Visiv-5, EXP U-Turn Stock, 4.6x30mm High Velocity) is now Build 1. The Osprey jumps to 15/23 as Biffle and GalaxyWZ leave the Squall, which falls to 1/23 (now Testing). Striga 4/23. No new Warzone patch and no loadout posts from the top-50 roster on X.

changelog.title: ISO Nightshade takes the close-range pick
changelog.text: Kitted now counts the ISO Nightshade on 11 of 25 tracked pros (8/32 on Nov 19), with Kenner moving over from the VEL and Apathy from the Kastov 762/Striga today. The VEL drops to 7/25 (9 at most counting HusKerrs and Symfuhny), so the ISO becomes the BR close-range pick and the VEL an alternative. Osprey 11/25 stays the long-range pick; Squall 5/25, Striga 3/25. Han 86 card gets Metaphor’s Nov 22 BR Solos gunsmith; Squall build now credited to HusKerrs. No new Warzone patch (Nov 23 weapon tuning is DMZ-only) and no loadout posts from the top-50 roster on X.

changelog.title: Cronen Squall added as long-range alternative
changelog.text: Kitted now lists the Cronen Squall as its #2 long-range gun: 7 of 32 pros counted (5 on Nov 16), with Biffle, Apathy and GalaxyWZ moving over from the Osprey; Hisoka's listed Squall carries Striga parts and is not counted. Osprey stays the pick at 12/32. Close range: VEL 12/32, ISO 8/32, Striga 5/32. No new Warzone patch and no loadout posts from the top-50 roster on X.

changelog.title: Cronen Osprey pulls away
changelog.text: Kitted now counts 13 of 31 pros on the Cronen Osprey, up from 9 yesterday (Aydan, Apathy, jboned and HalloWFR added), the biggest share of any gun. All 13 run the IO-556 TAC 18" barrel, 60 Round Mag and FSS IS300 Heavy Silencer. Close range: VEL 46 10/31, ISO Nightshade 7/31, Wz.55 Striga 7/31 (Newbz back to the VEL), so the Striga surge has paused and VEL stays the pick. No new Warzone patch and no loadout posts from the top-50 roster on X.

changelog.title: Striga one pro behind VEL
changelog.text: Kitted now counts 8 of 30 pros on the Wz.55 Striga (5 yesterday) and 9 on the VEL 46 (12 yesterday); FifaKill and Apathy moved from the VEL to the Striga and Krinkz went back to it. With Almond and Shifty's X posts the Striga has 10 named pros. VEL stays the close-range pick for now by one pro on Kitted. Striga consensus build: 50 Round Drum Mag, GW Sender 500, FTAC Silent Recon, Wire Stock. No new Warzone patch.

changelog.title: Wz.55 Striga gains ground
changelog.text: Kitted now counts 6 of 30 pros on the Wz.55 Striga (4 last night, 2 yesterday morning); Kenner and Krinkz moved over from the VEL 46. Eight named pros in all with Almond and Shifty's X posts. VEL 46 stays the close-range pick at 11 of 30 (down from 14). Kitted's Striga consensus build now matches Almond's tab. No new patch.

changelog.title: Wz.55 Striga Emerging
changelog.text: Wz.55 Striga moves from Testing to Emerging in BR close range: Almond and Shifty posted Striga builds on X (Shifty's after winning the $50k PullzeCheck event), and Kitted counts 4 of 30 pros. Six named pros in all; Hisoka probable. VEL 46 stays the pick (13 of 30). Two pro builds added as tabs.

changelog.title: Hitscan and ballistics update
changelog.text: Nov 11 patch notes raise every gun's hitscan range (about 35 m on average) and make long-range bullets land 34 ms sooner. Picks are unchanged: no tracked pro switched because of it yet. The TTK numbers below were measured before this change, so treat mid- and long-range figures as pre-patch. A semi-auto firing delay bug is also open.

changelog.title: Cronen Osprey
changelog.text: Cronen Osprey jumps to 11 of 29 tracked pros (from 7), including Hisoka, who dropped the Han 86. Han 86 now has no tracked pro and is marked a watch.

changelog.text: KG-7 Vulcan named BR long-range sniper pick (Testing); Mosin moved to alternative for medium-range quick-scoping.

changelog.text: Build tabs; aggregator builds added where no pro loadout exists. Competitive recipes are tabbed on the card, pro evidence first. A slot the source does not list stays unknown.

changelog.title: Multi-gun role cards, TTK section, Mineral Ledger redesign
changelog.text: Close range now groups a VEL 46 meta pick with ISO Nightshade and Wz.55 Striga as testing alternatives. ISO has no attachments: JGOD’s Nov 6 calculation is faster inside 15m and WZStats ranks it #1 close range, but no pro loadout was seen. Striga stays build-unverified and mode-unverified; Swagg calls it the fastest-killing SMG, and the JGOD and CODMunity calculators are charted separately. Cronen Osprey, Han 86, and Voyak stay single picks. Sniper and every Resurgence role stay empty. The TTK section labels calculator values CALC and does not merge the two sources’ buckets.

changelog.title: VEL versus ISO: usage is not faster TTK
changelog.text: Kept VEL Emerging but made the disagreement explicit: rolling-panel usage and direct Hisoka Hajin BR footage support VEL as a candidate; Swagg describes comfort/movement. JGOD’s launch-day calculations favor ISO at 0m and 15m, while VEL leads at 40m. These are calculations, not controlled tests. Hisoka’s readable four-part observation is separate from Spam’s build; fifth slot remains unverified.

changelog.title: Current-game-only cleanup
changelog.text: 10 of 11 prior role cards were removed from recommendation status; Cronen was the only current build retained after name/capture verification. Nine recommendations were withdrawn completely, while Voyak stays as one visible current-use Legacy exception without any attachment recipe. Prior 45 displayed rows across seven distinct recipes became 14 rows across three current MW4 recipes. An explicit sniper gap and Zodiac evidence gap are left empty. Historical values are retained in the local audit, not the recommendation table.

changelog.title: Dated-data and compatibility audit
changelog.text: FLS’s four-part ISO remains Nov 3; Hisoka’s former VEL list has old-game strings; the former KG-7/Astaroth entry is a pre-launch editorial build, not current pro evidence. A partial Han record was not made complete merely because current MW4 shared parts exist. Four launch-day pair reports replace nine current-or-historical pro rows. Exact individual dates are preserved; no stream title creates a gunsmith finding.
